sources.facts: Layered placement supports straight, orthogonal and spline routing and port constraints; its options include edge straightening.
sources.decision: Useful precedent for treating straightness as a separate objective. Replacing placement would exceed the requested default-turn scope and change established link identity and curves.

sources.facts: Routes edges with fixed node positions and few direction changes, with independently configured minimum spacing and port constraints.
sources.decision: Supports keeping direction simplification separate from gap reduction. Orthogonal routing does not match the existing continuous doublet geometry; no new dependency is needed.

local_components: glyph.linkCurve/approach already calculate the exact endpoint axis, avoiding duplicated angle-sign logic.
style.linkTurns/shapeOfStyle are shared by the editor, worker payload, preview and all image exports.
Existing painted-shape gap reduction and solveDebug diagnostics remain available and unchanged.
The gallery and rain deliberately use legacy mirror/bulge geometry rather than editor fixed-angle defaults; their historical drawing digest remains a regression invariant.
external_issue: The root cause is local default selection. No defect in an external repository was identified, so no unrelated upstream issue is warranted.
